question: Who must sign the Authority to Release Personal Information form?

claims.text: The form must be signed by the applicant and, as applicable, their spouse or common-law partner if they also wish to release personal information to the same designated individual.

claims.text: Dependent children 18 years of age or older must complete their own form if they wish to authorize the release of their information to a designated individual.
